votes.motion: Approve the RDA minutes from June 15, 2021.
votes.description: The Board approved the meeting minutes from the June 15, 2021 RDA meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt the third amendment to Resolution 12 of 2022, to the Operating Agreement for the Utah Performing Arts Center and Resolution 13 of 2022, the Third Amendment to UPAC Operating Agreement.
votes.description: The Board adopted resolutions approving changes to two interlocal agreements between Salt Lake City, the RDA, and the Utah Performing Arts Center Agency (UPACA) related to insurance for operation of the Eccles Theater, intended to streamline processes and save taxpayer money.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 14 of 2022, approving the term sheet for a loan to the Bicycle Collective for a commercial development project located at approximately 901 South Gale Street.
votes.description: The Board approved a loan of up to $2,250,000 (a $500,000 increase) at a locked-in base interest rate to the Bicycle Collective to fund construction of its nonprofit headquarters along the 9-Line Trail.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 15 of 2022, approving the term sheet for a loan to the Fisher Brewing Company, LLC for a Granary District Adaptive Reuse Project located at approximately 316 West 800 South.
votes.description: The Board approved a forgivable loan of $136,962 to Fisher Brewing Company LLC from the Granary District Adaptive Reuse Program to fund brewery and taproom expansion construction.
The Board approved the consent agenda, which included setting a date of November 10, 2022 to accept public comment and consider adopting RDA Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2022-23.
